title: Incident Manager (CSIRT)
description:
**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for an Incident Manager to team up with the most dedicated team of cyber specialists in our Incident Response domain.**

##### **About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company**


Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.


Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.


Today, we employ around 440 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for an Incident Manager who wants to make a difference in our CSIRT.

##### **CSIRT (Cybersecurity Incident Response Team)**


Our Cybersecurity Incident Response Team (CSIRT) manages most of the large cybersecurity incidents in the Nordics. The team consists of dedicated experts in forensics, advanced infrastructure, and incident management, and works tirelessly to solve the most challenging technical situations. Together, we have rescued countless global organizations from cyber attacks and helped them get back to business with minimal impact.

##### **The Role**


As a Cyber Incident Manager, you are responsible for coordinating incident engagements from initial response through containment, forensic investigation, recovery, and post-incident activities.
  

  

You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams consisting of forensic investigators, recovery specialists, infrastructure experts, legal advisors, and customer stakeholders. At the same time, you will act as a trusted advisor to customer representatives throughout the incident lifecycle.
  

  

Your focus will be on driving progress, aligning priorities, coordinating stakeholders, and ensuring that response and recovery activities move forward efficiently. You will gradually be taking on increasing responsibility as you develop your leadership, stakeholder management, customer advisory, and crisis coordination capabilities.


Key Responsibilities

* Lead and coordinate cybersecurity incident response engagements.
* Act as a primary point of contact for customers and stakeholders during incidents.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams consisting of technical and business specialists.
* Drive recovery efforts to minimize business disruption and downtime.
* Provide guidance and recommendations throughout the incident lifecycle.
* Support customers in strengthening resilience and preparedness after incidents.
* Contribute to the continuous development of Truesec incident response capabilities and methodologies.

##### **Your Potential Background**


We believe you have a background in cyber security, IT operations, managed services, consulting, technical account management, service delivery, project coordination, or a similar field.


You enjoy collaborating with both technical specialists and business stakeholders, bringing structure to challenging situations and helping teams to prioritize the work toward a common goal.

**Required Skills**

* Understanding how modern IT environments and services are operated and supported.
* Experience leading major incidents, service disruptions, or crisis situations.
* Experience advising senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
* Ability to build trusted relationships with technical specialists and business stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a pragmatic mindset.
* Professional proficiency in English and Danish, both written and spoken.
**Meritorious Experience**

* Experience within cybersecurity incident response, digital forensics, SOC operations, or managed security services.
* Understanding of compliance, regulatory, legal, and information protection requirements.
* Background in consulting or customer-facing advisory roles.
* Experience with cloud security and hybrid IT environments.
* Knowledge of cyber risk management, business continuity, and resilience.

  

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Swedish citizenship or citizenship in another EU country. Language skills in English and Swedish is required.

##### **Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future**


If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.


So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

title: Account Manager
description:
**Location**
------------


Stockholm


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Department**
--------------


GTM DepartmentSales


**Compensation**
----------------


* $230K – $350K • Offers Equity

  
**About Us:**
**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.

  

  

Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale.  



  

We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation.  



  

Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g.,Seaborn,Luigi), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience.


**The Role**
------------


This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You’ll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won’t be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you’ll be a credible partner in those conversations.


The profile we’re hiring is a technical account manager. You’ve worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can work credibly with everyone from a CxO to a Developer.


*What the role is*


* An early seat. You’re helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence this team figures out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you
* A technical customer-facing role. You’ll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they’re building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it’s needed
* A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences

*What the role is not*


* A traditional post-sales role. You’re measured on revenue, not health scores
* An on-call support function. You’re not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You’re growing accounts
* A technical delivery role. You’re not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people
* A fully built motion. Much of this is still being built. If you spot gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook, you help build them
* A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer company team self. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. “this is my job”

**What You’ll Work On:**
------------------------


* Build Modal’s account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account’s first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to engage confidently with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and find expansion opportunities

**You May Be a Fit If:**
------------------------


* You’ve owned a revenue target or supported one in a highly technical, consumption business.
* You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.

title: Postdoc to the Clinical Memory Researchs unit
description:
Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset.




**Description of the workplace**  

The position is based in the Clinical Memory Research Group at the Department of Clinical Sciences Malmö, Lund University, with placement at the Biomedical Centre (BMC) in Lund. The group is led by Professor Niklas Mattsson-Carlgren and Associate Professor Sebastian Palmqvist and conducts the BioFINDER studies, in which patients and cognitively healthy volunteers undergo brain imaging, biomarker assessments, and neuropsychological testing (https://biofinder.se).


You will be part of an interdisciplinary research environment comprising clinicians, imaging analysts, statisticians, bioinformaticians, and laboratory scientists, working closely with groups generating genetic and proteomic data.


We are committed to maintaining a positive work environment characterized by respect and consideration, and we strive to provide a workplace that is both stimulating and supportive for all employees.

**Project description**  

Large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have identified genetic risk factors for Alzheimer’s disease, but for most risk loci the underlying genes and mechanisms remain unknown. The aim of this project is to link genetic risk to measurable protein changes and ultimately to causal genes, in order to prioritize novel therapeutic targets and biomarkers.


You will work with genetic data from BioFINDER and international consortia together with large-scale proteomics data from plasma and cerebrospinal fluid, linked to neuroimaging, neuropathology, and clinical outcomes.

**Duties and responsibilities**  

At Lund University, employment as a postdoctoral researcher is intended to provide opportunities for both scientific and pedagogical development. The primary focus is on research merits, although higher education teaching and pedagogical training may also be included.


You will have primary responsibility for genetic and proteomic analyses of high-dimensional data from patients and control participants. Tasks include:

* Independently conducting genome-wide association studies (GWAS) and downstream analyses, including heritability analyses, genetic correlation analyses, colocalization analyses, and Mendelian randomization.
* Integrating genetic data with proteomics (pQTL analyses) and other omics data to identify causal genes and biological pathways.
* Developing reproducible analysis pipelines for large-scale data in HPC and cloud computing environments.
* Writing scientific publications and presenting research findings at international conferences.
* Collaborating with research group members and external partners, as well as supervising PhD students and students.


Teaching and other duties within the research group may also be included.

**Qualifications**  

The following qualifications are required:

* A PhD degree or equivalent foreign degree in genetics, bioinformatics, computational biology, statistics, epidemiology, computer science, biomedicine, or a related field. The doctoral degree must be completed before the employment decision is made.
* Demonstrated ability to develop and conduct high-quality research.
* Teaching and pedagogical skills.
* Strong expertise in statistical genetics of complex diseases, including GWAS, heritability analyses, Mendelian randomization, and polygenic risk scoring.
* Experience in analyzing large-scale proteomics data or integrating proteomics with genetic data.
* Excellent skills in statistical programming using R and/or Python, as well as experience with Linux and large-scale analyses on HPC clusters or cloud platforms.
* Strong ability to work independently and in a structured manner, with excellent collaborative, initiative-taking, and analytical skills.
* Excellent written and spoken English skills.


The following qualifications are considered meritorious:

* Preference will be given to applicants who obtained their doctoral degree no more than three years before the application deadline.
* Experience in linking risk variants to genes and biological function (variant-to-gene and variant-to-function mapping).
* Experience integrating genetic data with single-cell or spatial transcriptomics.
* Experience with AI models in genetic research.
* Experience in genetically informed drug target prioritization.
* Experience working with large cohort studies or international consortia.
* Experience writing research grant applications and obtaining independent research funding.
* A specific interest in dementia and ageing-related diseases.


Applicants will primarily be assessed on their scientific merits and potential as researchers. Particular emphasis will be placed on scientific expertise within the subject area.

**We offer**  

Lund University is a government agency, which means that you will receive attractive employment benefits, generous annual leave, and an occupational pension plan. We also offer a flexible working hours agreement that supports a healthy work-life balance.


For more information about working at Lund University, please visit: Work with us

**About the position**  

This is a full-time fixed-term position (100%) for two years, starting on 1 January 2027 or as otherwise agreed. You are expected to perform your work on-site in Lund.


Employment as a postdoctoral researcher is limited to a minimum of two years and a maximum of three years in accordance with the collective agreement governing fixed-term postdoctoral employment. A postdoctoral position is intended as an early career stage appointment and an opportunity to further develop and broaden research expertise.

**How to apply**  

Applications must be submitted through the University’s recruitment system. The application should include: A cover letter describing how you meet the required qualifications and why you are interested in the position, Curriculum vitae (CV), including a publication list, degree certificate(s) and academic transcripts, contact details for two referees and any additional documents you wish to submit in support of your application.


The Faculty of Medicine is a part of Lund University, and is responsible for education and research within medicine and healthcare. Our academic programs are closely linked with the healthcare system and are firmly anchored in the faculty’s strong research tradition. Our research spans a broad field within experimental preclinical research, near-patient clinical research and health sciences research. The Faculty of Medicine, with its 1,800 employees and 2,700 students in Lund and Malmö, is a knowledge-intensive meeting place for students, teachers and researchers from all over the world.


The Department of Clinical Sciences, Malmö is one of the six departments at the Faculty of Medicine, Lund University. We have a strong focus on clinical and epidemiological research and also conduct an extensive preclinical laboratory research.


We kindly decline all sales and marketing contacts.

**Help companies grow and face the future**

### **Why Avaus?**


We are the leading marketing and sales transformation partner in the Nordics! We are 60+ colleagues located at our offices in Stockholm, Helsinki, and Munich, backed by 17+ years of experience in data-driven marketing and sales across B2C and B2B industries.


Our vision is to become Europe’s leading boutique consultancy focused on leveraging data, automation, and AI in marketing and sales to drive business growth and efficiency. We are a social, ambitious crew of cross-competence experts in strategy, data & analytics, technology and marketing activation who are passionate about growing our clients' businesses and building first-class digital experiences. No hierarchies or unnecessary bureaucracy, just fast decisions, close collaboration, and high ownership of your projects and development.

### **The role**


In this role, you will be a crucial part of Avaus and our client assignments, working closely with our larger enterprise clients to help them transform their ways of working. You will operate at the intersection of business, data, and technology and bridging strategic vision with hands-on technical execution.

  

Rather than just designing static architectures, you will activate data using AI, smart automation, and modern MarTech stacks across both marketing and sales.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Act as a trusted advisor and architectural domain expert, assessing clients’ tech environments and actively driving them to become more AI-ready.
* Design and lead the rollout of end-to-end, AI-powered data activations, integrating predictive models, dynamic triggers, and agentic workflows seamlessly into client marketing and sales ecosystems.
* Translate complex business goals into scalable omnichannel customer journeys, lead management frameworks, and automated sales/marketing handovers.
* Define data specifications, identity resolution rules, and consent logic alongside data engineering and IT teams.
* Bring what we build internally into client delivery, ensuring AI use cases run securely and compliantly within client environments.
* Coach client teams and junior colleagues, driving change management and technical enablement so solutions actually stick and deliver measurable ROI.
* Rapidly build working prototypes and visual proof-of-concepts using modern AI tools to demonstrate the art of the possible and inspire client stakeholders

### **Who you are**


You have a solid background as a Solutions Architect, or similar technical lead, in the data, MarTech, or customer engagement space. More importantly, you have "taken the AI pill": you are already an AI-native practitioner (or well on your way) who uses modern AI tools daily to solve problems faster, smarter, and more creatively.


You are curious, pragmatic, and comfortable leading dialogues and presentations with both technical specialists and senior business stakeholders. Beside your personality, we would also like you to have:

* Proven experience designing end-to-end solution architectures and complex enterprise data flows across source systems, analytics, CDPs, and Marketing & Sales technologies.
* Hands-on familiarity with modern activation, CDP, and Reverse ETL ecosystems (e.g., Braze, Hightouch, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, Voyado, HubSpot).
* Experience working with, or a deep curiosity for, generative AI, predictive modeling, and agentic workflows in a commercial setting.
* Daily fluency in AI-assisted development and productivity platforms (such as Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot, etc.).
* Sound judgment on build vs. buy, plus a solid grasp of governance, compliance, and security (GDPR, ISO 27001, EU AI Act).
* Experience in B2B environments (B2C experience is a strong plus).
* Fluent in Swedish and English.

### **Practical Information**


This is a permanent position with a 6-month probation period, based at our Stockholm office at Drottninggatan. We offer a hybrid remote workplace. You will report to the Head of Delivery and be part of our Tech & Activation Competence team.

**Brinner du för försäljning, är hungrig på resultat och älskar att skapa relationer? Då kan du vara vår nästa stjärna!**  

  

Nu söker vi en **Inhouse Sales Agent** som vill vara med och utveckla vår försäljning och skapa oförglömliga upplevelser för våra kunder.


Som Inhouse Sales Agent är du navet i vår försäljning av möten och event. Du arbetar proaktivt och strukturerat med inkommande förfrågningar, skapar offerter och håller en nära dialog med kunder – från första kontakt till bokning. Telefonen och mejlen är dina bästa vänner, och du ser varje samtal som en möjlighet att bygga relationer och driva affären framåt.


Du får energi av att nå resultat, är snabb och effektiv i ditt arbete och älskar att skräddarsy lösningar som överträffar kundens förväntningar. Hos oss värnar vi om långsiktiga relationer – vi vill inte bara boka nästa affär, vi vill bygga framtidens samarbeten.


Du kommer jobba mot Hagastrands övergripande vision och försäljningsmål och vilja ge kunden den bästa service den förtjänar. Sammanfattningsvis vill du se resultat, ha roligt på jobbet och vara en stolt representant för Hagastrand.


**Vad vi förväntar oss av dig:**
  

Att du bidrar till att Hagastrand fortsätter skapa oförglömliga minnen för både företag och privatpersoner. Du tar hand om inkommande förfrågningar och ser till att konvertera dem till affärer. Du bygger vidare på relationer med befintliga kunder samtidigt som du proaktivt bearbetar nya. Du arbetar målmedvetet för att nå budget och trivs med att jobba nära drift och dina kollegor för att säkerställa bästa möjliga upplevelse för våra gäster.


#### **Vem är det vi söker?**


* Har kunskap från eventbranschen och försäljning
* Det är viktigt att du är resultatdriven, lösningsfokuserad och får energi av kundkontakt
* Trivs i högt tempo, har stark ansvarskänsla och gillar att jobba mot tydliga mål
* Är social och en genuin relationsbyggare
* Är trygg i att arbeta med telefon, mejl och boknings-/offertsystem
* Har förmåga att lyssna in kundens behov och omvandla det till rätt lösning
* Har en attityd där allting är möjligt och där kunden/gästen alltid är i fokus
* Är snabb, strukturerad och effektiv – utan att kompromissa med kvaliteten
* Är bekväm med att arbeta självständigt men också i fullt tempo tillsammans med kollegor

#### **Kvalifikationer**


* Minst 1 års erfarenhet av innesälj inom hotell eller venue sales (t.ex. hotell, festvåning eller mötes- och eventlokaler)
* Utmärkta kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift
* Goda datakunskaper
* Stort plus om du har arbetat i bokningssystemet Opera V5 / Opera Cloud

#### **Vi erbjuder**


* En spännande utmaning och stimulerande arbete inom familjeägda koncernen Nobis Hospitality Group.
* En internationell arbetsplats med en levande kultur och stor mångfald bland både kollegor och gäster.
* En varierad arbetsplats med allt mellan eventlokaler, restauranger, hotell och spa under samma tak.

En arbetsplats där vi har högt i tak och ett resultatorienterat team  
* 

**Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid (100%) med 6 månaders provanställning. Tillträde och lön enligt överenskommelse. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande – skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.**

title: Business Development Intern
description:
**Company Description** **People first. Business follows.**


Devoteam | Stockholm | Mid-January – Mid-May 2027


We believe people buy from people they like.


Not because someone delivered the perfect sales pitch, but because they listened, understood the problem and built trust.


We're looking for a Business Development Intern who wants to learn how great marketing and great sales work together.


You'll join Devoteam in Stockholm, working directly with our sales teams and closely with our Nordic marketing leadership.


You'll be the bridge between the two. And we don't mean forwarding leads from one team to another.


We mean understanding how marketing creates opportunities, how sales builds relationships and how the two can work together to create real business.

 **Job Description** **What you'll actually do**

* Work directly with our salespeople across the Nordics, helping them identify and develop new opportunities.
* Connect our marketing campaigns, events and activities with real sales conversations.
* Research companies, industries and decision-makers to understand what matters to them.
* Help create relevant, personalised outreach that makes people want to respond.
* Work with our teams across Google Cloud, Microsoft, AWS and other technology partners.
* Learn how to use CRM systems, prospecting tools, automation and modern intelligence tools.
* Join planning meetings, contribute ideas and help improve how our sales and marketing teams work together.
* Help us understand what works, what doesn't and what we should do differently.

**How we think about sales**


Sales isn't about being the loudest person in the room.


It's about curiosity. Listening. Understanding people. Building relationships that last.


We don't believe in sending a thousand meaningless messages and hoping someone replies.


We believe in doing your homework, finding something relevant to say and treating people like people.


And we believe marketing and sales should be on the same team, not working in separate worlds.


That's the kind of business development we want you to learn.

 **Qualifications** **Who we're looking for**


You don't need a perfect CV or previous sales experience.


You might be studying business, marketing, technology or something entirely different.


What matters is who you are and how you think.


You're curious about people and business. You're comfortable asking questions. You take initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.


You're interested in technology and how it changes the way companies work.


You like solving problems, and you're not afraid to challenge an idea if you think there's a better approach.


You also understand that being good with people means treating them with respect.


Fluent English is important. Swedish or another Nordic language is a plus.

 **Additional Information** **Our culture**


We believe in trust, not micromanagement.


In giving people responsibility, including those at the beginning of their careers.


In being honest, supporting each other and sharing what we know.


We want people who bring ideas, ask questions, make mistakes, learn from them and keep getting better.


Your job title doesn't determine whether your idea is worth listening to.


And while we're part of a large international company, we want our teams to feel personal, open and collaborative.


Attitude matters more to us than experience.

**What you'll take away**


You'll get firsthand exposure to how a technology business operates, working alongside experienced salespeople, marketers and business leaders.


You'll learn how to research accounts, build relationships, develop opportunities and connect commercial strategy with marketing execution.


You'll receive guidance, regular feedback and opportunities to take ownership of projects suited to your experience.


Above all, we want you to leave with practical skills, meaningful work you can demonstrate and a clearer understanding of where you want to go next.

**The details**

* Location: Stockholm, Sweden
* Dates: Mid-January to mid-May 2027
* Type: Unpaid, supervised internship
* Team: Nordic Sales & Marketing, Devoteam Cloud Platforms
* Placement: Intended for students undertaking an approved educational or equivalent internship programme

**Interested?**


Send us your CV and a short introduction.


But skip the generic cover letter.


Tell us what makes you curious about people, sales and business. Tell us about something you took the initiative to do.


We want to see how you think, not just where you've studied.

**Come with curiosity. Leave with experience.**

title: Creative Marketing Intern
description:
**Company Description** **Show us what you've got.**


Devoteam | Stockholm | Mid-January – Mid-May 2027


We don't believe good marketing starts with a template.


It starts with curiosity, creativity and understanding people.


We believe marketing should make people feel something. Start conversations. Build relationships. Create experiences worth remembering.


And most importantly, help the business move forward.


We're looking for a Creative Marketing Intern who wants to make things, try things and show us what they're capable of.


You'll work directly with our Nordic CMO, alongside Audrey, Aleksandra and Michelle, and collaborate with our teams across the Nordics.


You'll be part of the marketing team supporting Devoteam's Cloud Platforms business, covering Google Cloud, Microsoft and AWS, while also contributing to our wider businesses and potentially projects for the international Devoteam Group.


This is an opportunity to have your work seen far beyond Stockholm.

 **Job Description** **What you'll actually do**

* Create content for social media, websites, campaigns and events.
* Design graphics, presentations, visual identities and marketing material.
* Film, edit and produce videos, from quick social clips to more ambitious creative projects.
* Help develop concepts for events, experiences and campaigns that people actually remember.
* Work with our sales teams to create content and tools they can genuinely use.
* Tell stories about our people, customers, partners and the work they do.
* Experiment with creative technology, intelligence tools and automation.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland and potentially our international marketing teams.
* Bring ideas we haven't thought of yet.

**How we think about marketing**


Here's a question we ask ourselves:

**Can a salesperson actually use this?**


Because a beautiful campaign that doesn't help anyone isn't enough.


We don't believe in marketing for the sake of marketing.


We don't want another generic webinar, another meaningless LinkedIn post or another campaign that looks exactly like everyone else's.


We want to create things that get people talking.


Things people remember.


Things that bring our customers, partners and teams closer together.


And we believe the best marketing is human.


Technology can make us faster and smarter. But creativity, empathy, good judgement and understanding people are what make the difference.

 **Qualifications** **Who we're looking for**


Maybe you're studying marketing, communication, graphic design, film or digital media.


Maybe you're self-taught.


Maybe you've spent years making videos, designing things, experimenting with technology or creating content simply because you love doing it.


We're interested in what you can do, not just what you've studied.


We'd love someone with:

* A strong eye for design, composition and visual storytelling.
* Video editing skills and an interest in motion, photography or animation.
* Experience with tools like Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar.
* Curiosity about tools like Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT and new creative workflows.
* An understanding of social media and what makes content interesting.
* The confidence to share ideas and the humility to learn from others.


You don't need all these skills.


But you should enjoy creating things.


And if you've figured out a clever way to use technology to make something better, we'd love to see it.

 **Additional Information** **The culture you'll join**


We believe great ideas can come from anywhere.


From the CMO. From a designer. From someone who's been here for ten years. Or someone who's been here for ten days.


We value creativity, courage, curiosity and people who take ownership.


We trust people to do good work and give them room to figure out how.


We share knowledge, give honest feedback and help each other get better.


We don't expect everything to work the first time.


But we expect people to care about what they create, to learn and to keep improving.


And we believe work should be enjoyable. You should be able to laugh with your colleagues, challenge each other and feel proud of what you've built together.

**What's in it for you?**


You'll have direct access to Nordic marketing leadership and work closely with people who create campaigns, events and experiences across multiple countries and businesses.


You'll get to work on real projects with experienced colleagues who can help you develop your skills.


You'll have room to experiment, propose ideas and own pieces of work.


And you'll see how creativity connects with sales, technology, customers and business strategy.


Some projects will be local. Others could reach audiences across the Nordics or the wider Devoteam Group.


We want you to finish this internship with a stronger portfolio, new skills, good relationships and a few things you're genuinely proud to say you created.

**The details**

* Location: Stockholm, Sweden
* Dates: Mid-January to mid-May 2027
* Type: Unpaid, supervised internship
* Team: Nordic Marketing, Devoteam Cloud Platforms
* Supervision: Directly with the Nordic CMO, supported by Audrey, Aleksandra and Michelle
* Placement: Intended for students undertaking an approved educational or equivalent internship programme

**Interested?**


Send us your CV. But more importantly, show us something you've made.


A video. A design. A website. A personal project. An Instagram account. Something weird you experimented with.


We don't care if it was for a client, a school project or just for fun.


Tell us what you made, why you made it and what you'd do differently next time.


We want to see your imagination, your curiosity and your potential.

**Don't tell us you're creative. Show us.**

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
Vi söker en senior Account Manager som vill ta en nyckelroll i vår fortsatta tillväxtresa i och runt Örebro. Rollen handlar främst om att utveckla och expandera långsiktiga kundrelationer hos några av regionens mest intressanta verksamheter. Samtidigt förväntas du identifiera och skapa nya affärsmöjligheter hos nya strategiskt viktiga kunder.


Vi befinner vi oss på en spännande tillväxtresa där du får möjlighet att påverka vår utveckling i regionen. Du får stor frihet under ansvar, kompetenta kollegor och möjlighet att göra skillnad hos några av Sveriges mest intressanta kunder.

### **Är du den vi söker?**


I rollen som Senior Accout Manager kommer du ansvara för och utveckla ett antal strategiskt viktiga kunder. För att lyckas i rollen tror vi även att du trivs med att:

Du är en person som:

* Kombinerar affärsmässighet med relationsbyggande
* Är självgående, strukturerad och trygg i kunddialogen
* Är prestigelös och delar Omegapoints filosofi om att vara både vass och snäll

### **Vi ser att du har**

* Minst fem års erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning inom IT, konsultverksamhet eller digital transformation
* Vana att arbeta med större kunder och flera kontaktytor, från verksamhetsansvariga till ledningsgrupper. Du har dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utveckla kundrelationer över tid och skapa lönsam tillväxt
* Skicklighet att samla rätt kompetens runt kunden och tillsammans med specialister och leveransansvariga kan forma affärer som löser verkliga verksamhetsproblem

Omegapoint är byggt för lärande. Här får du:

* En kultur där vi är både vassa och snälla
* Kollegor som gärna delar med sig, stöttar och inspirerar


Tillsammans bygger vi säkra digitala lösningar som skapar långsiktigt värde.

### **Om oss**


Omegapoint är norra Europas ledande konsultbolag inom säker digital innovation. Vi är över 900 medarbetare i Stockholm, Göteborg, Malmö, Örebro, Västerås, Enköping, Uppsala och Umeå.

**Ett tips innan du söker:**  

Du behöver inte optimera ditt CV för något automatiskt urvalssystem. Vi använder inte AI för att fatta rekryteringsbeslut och läser alla ansökningar själva.  

  

Fokusera i stället på att beskriva vad du har gjort, vilka problem du har löst och vad du vill utvecklas vidare inom - vi vill lära känna dig.  

  

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: QA Automation Engineer / SDET
description:
**About The Role:**


We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer / SDET with a strong focus on backend and API testing, who will own and drive automated testing in a complex, distributed system. This is an automation‑first role with a clear engineering approach to quality, stability, and system reliability.

 **What You'll Do (Responsibilities):**

* Design, develop, and maintain API automation tests
* Work with relational databases for data validation and integrity checks
* Dockerize test frameworks and test execution
* Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline
* Messaging systems (RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.)
* Confident knowledge of Java (or a similar OOP language)
* Maintain and continuously improve the test automation framework
* Use and maintain Test Management tools (TestRail or equivalent)
* Collaborate closely with developers during early validation phases

* Solid experience in API automation testing (RestAssured, JSON validation)
* Understanding of backend systems and microservices architecture
* Experience working with relational databases (SQL, procedures)

**Nice to have:**

* Experience in boosting routine activities with AI tools and agents
* Performance testing

 **Why Join Paysend?**

Join a company that is transforming how people and businesses move money around the world. Your work will contribute to products and services that help millions of customers stay connected globally.

We empower our people to take ownership, make decisions, and drive real impact. You'll have the opportunity to shape solutions, challenge the status quo, and see the results of your work firsthand.

As a fast-growing global fintech, we offer opportunities to learn, develop new skills, take on new challenges, and advance your career across functions and geographies.

* **Be Part of Our Journey:**


We're building the future of the global money movement. Join us at an exciting stage of growth where your ideas, expertise, and contributions can help shape what's next.

title: Communications and Content Officer
description:
**The European Broadcasting Union EBU is looking for a Communications and Content Officer.**

**ABOUT THE EBU MEMBER RELATIONS & COMMUNICATIONS DEPARTMENT**


The EBU Communications Team is a busy, multi-skilled department. It covers corporate communications, media relations, direct marketing, digital communications, website content and social media. We work across the entire EBU, collaborating with teams and departments throughout the organization to deliver high-quality, engaging communications that support and showcase the EBU’s work.

**PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES OF THIS POSITION**


Reporting to the Head of Content Communications, you will take day-to-day responsibility for communications relating to EBU Sport and Eurovision Sport, alongside an agreed portfolio of other priority EBU activities. You will:

* Act as the principal day-to-day Content Communications contact for EBU Sport and Eurovision Sport
* Develop and deliver communications plans and narratives, including press releases, announcements, media relations and messaging across EBU channels
* Create and commission compelling content, with an emphasis on social-first storytelling, video and engaging digital formats
* Contribute to the development and implementation of the EBU’s social media and platform strategies
* Use audience insight, analytics and emerging trends to inform content and channel decisions, working with colleagues in social media analytics and audience insight
* Explore and apply AI-enabled tools to improve content creation and workflows, while maintaining strong editorial judgement and standards
* Provide communications counsel to senior EBU colleagues within your portfolio, including messaging, presentations, speeches and thought leadership
* Contribute to major campaigns, events and priority EBU moments, and help strengthen content and channel capability across the team
* Manage external creative resources where required, including agencies, freelancers and production partners

**YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE**

* 3 to 6 years of relevant experience in sport communications, content, digital media or a related field, ideally within an international, media or similarly complex organization
* Demonstrable experience of media relations and press office communications, including press releases, media enquiries and translating complex or sensitive subjects into clear external messaging
* Experience working with sports media and building relationships with journalists, ideally within the European sports media landscape
* A proven track record of delivering communications and content for different audiences and channels
* Excellent editorial judgement and writing skills, with the ability to turn complex subjects into clear and compelling narratives
* Strong understanding of social media and digital content, including platform-specific storytelling, video and audience engagement
* Experience using audience insight and analytics to inform content decisions
* Excellent stakeholder and project management skills, with the confidence to advise senior colleagues
* Proactive and self-sufficient, taking ownership of your work and driving ideas through to delivery with minimal supervision
* Curiosity about emerging technology, and practical experience of, or enthusiasm for, using AI in content and communications workflows

**LANGUAGE**  

Native or near-native English, with the ability to produce polished, publication-ready copy. French would be a significant advantage.

**EDUCATION**  

University degree (Bachelor’s level).

**ADDED VALUE**


Additional experience in the following areas would be a bonus:

* Familiarity with tools such as Cision, Meltwater, Hootsuite, Asana, Adobe Creative Cloud, Canva and CapCut, or equivalent platforms
* Knowledge of the European media landscape, and an understanding of, or passion for, public service media and the EBU’s mission
* French language skills

**ONCE ON BOARD, YOU WILL**


Be part of an outstanding, diverse, inclusive, multicultural and international team.


Work with accomplished and engaging professionals coming from a wide variety of backgrounds and covering an impressive range of professions both in and outside of the broadcasting realm.

**ABOUT THE EBU**


Discover more about the EBU at www.ebu.ch.

**ADDITIONAL INFORMATION**


More info in the job in the following link: 2026\_EBU\_ JD\_ Communications and Content Officer .pdf


We will not accept any applications after the closing date and we will contact only to candidates who meet the requirements.


The EBU is an equal opportunities employer committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels heard, safe and valued through a culture free of discrimination. We welcome applications from all communities.

**ONLY APPLICATIONS VIA OUR RECRUITMENT PORTAL WILL BE CONSIDERED.**

title: Business Controller
description:
**Role Purpose**


Build and own the financial controlling framework for X Shore's manufacturing operations, with a strong focus on cash flow management, production costs, profitability and reliable financial reporting.


Take ownership of financial processes and the finance-related implementation of ERP systems as the company scales.

**Core Mission**


Turn financial and operational data into clear decisions that help X Shore grow.


You'll work closely with the CFO, production, purchasing and management to establish financial control across the business — from understanding the cost of every boat we build to forecasting cash requirements and improving working capital.


This is a hands-on role in a growing manufacturing company where processes, systems and reporting structures are still being developed. You'll have the opportunity to build them rather than simply inherit them.

**What You'll Own**

* Drive cash flow management. Build and maintain short- and medium-term cash flow forecasts, monitor liquidity, manage working capital and identify actions to improve cash flow.
* Own production controlling. Develop product costing, BOM-based cost analysis, inventory valuation, production cost tracking and margin reporting.
* Turn data into decisions. Deliver budgets, forecasts, financial analysis, KPIs and management reporting that support operational and strategic decisions.
* Own financial ERP processes. Lead finance-related requirements, implementation and ongoing development of ERP systems. Ensure reliable master data and integration between purchasing, inventory, production and finance.
* Strengthen end-to-end processes. Establish effective order-to-cash (O2C) and purchase-to-pay (P2P) processes with clear financial controls, reliable information and strong working capital management.
* Oversee financial reporting. Coordinate, instruct and quality-assure monthly and annual closing, financial statements and reporting prepared by our external accounting provider.
* Support group reporting. Coordinate and analyse financial information across our Swedish operations and international subsidiaries, including our US subsidiary.
* Improve financial control. Establish practical routines, reporting tools and internal controls that provide transparency and support a growing organisation.
**What You Bring**

* Solid experience in business controlling within a manufacturing or industrial environment.
* Strong understanding of production costs, product costing, inventory and manufacturing processes.
* Proven experience in cash flow forecasting, liquidity management, budgeting and financial analysis.
* Good accounting knowledge, including monthly and annual closing, financial reporting and balance sheet management.
* Practical experience with ERP systems in a manufacturing environment, including financial processes and integration with operations.
* Advanced Excel skills combined with practical experience using AI tools to structure, analyse and communicate complex financial information.
* A hands-on, analytical and solution-oriented approach, comfortable working in an environment where processes and systems are still evolving.
* The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with production, purchasing and management.

What's Great to Have

* Experience implementing or improving manufacturing ERP systems such as Monitor ERP, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Supply Chain Management or similar platforms.
* Experience with BOM, COGS and other industrial manufacturing structures, standard costing, work in progress (WIP) and inventory valuation.
* Experience coordinating outsourced accounting and working with international subsidiaries.
* Experience with cloud-based accounting systems, financial reporting platforms and business intelligence tools.
* Experience from a growing manufacturing business, turnaround or operational scale-up.
* Experience with contract administration, compliance or corporate governance.

What Success Looks Like

* Reliable cash flow forecasts that give management visibility and control over liquidity.
* Clear product costing and margin analysis for every boat we build.
* Accurate inventory and production cost reporting that supports purchasing and operational decisions.
* Effective order-to-cash and purchase-to-pay processes that improve working capital and financial control.
* Financial reporting that is timely, reliable and actionable.
* Financial processes and ERP structures that support increasing production volumes.
* A finance function that helps the business anticipate problems and make better decisions rather than simply reporting what happened.

At X Shore, financial control is not just about numbers. It is about ensuring that the right decisions are made, resources are used effectively and the business can grow sustainably.


If you want to build the financial backbone of a company transforming the boating industry, this is your opportunity.

**Apply**


Employment: Permanent position (tillsvidareanställning). We are primarily looking for a permanent employee but are open to an initial consultancy arrangement with the intention of transitioning to permanent employment.

**Location:** X Shore Factory & HQ, Nyköping, Sweden. Primarily on-site.

**Language:** Fluent English, spoken and written. Swedish is meriting.

**Reporting to:** CFO

**Last application date:** 30 November 2026


Applications will be reviewed and interviews conducted on a rolling basis, starting immediately. We intend to conclude the recruitment process as soon as we identify the right candidate and may close applications before the stated deadline. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

title: Kreativ mäklarkoordinator till HusmanHagberg Uppsala
description:
Nu söker vi en mäklarkoordinator till vårt kontor i Uppsala! Är du intresserad av inredning, fotografering, gillar högt tempo och ser att vara serviceminded som en självklarhet? - **Då kan den här tjänsten vara något för dig!**  

  

Vi är på jakt efter en engagerad och självgående mäklarkoordinator som vill bli en viktig och avgörande del av vårt team. Rollen passar dig som är strukturerad, initiativrik och lösningsorienterad, med ett genuint intresse för styling och visuell kommunikation. Du har öga för detaljer, gillar kundkontakt och har ett naturligt affärstänk. En säljkoordinator är spindeln i nätet som inte missar några detaljer, är lösningsfokuserad och tar ett stort ansvar. Du är kontorets ansikte utåt och hjälper kollegorna genom hela försäljningsprocessen. Tillsammans med oss bidrar du till framgångsrika bostadsaffärer och nöjda kunder. **Hos oss får du en spännande vardag där du både själv får utvecklas och vara med att påverka!**  

  

Välkommen till ett lag som vinner tillsammans!  

  

**Om rollen**  

Som mäklarkoordinator får du en central och varierad roll där du arbetar nära våra fastighetsmäklare och ansvarar för att skapa struktur och ett smidigt flöde i den dagliga verksamheten.


Du kombinerar administrativa uppgifter med kreativa och säljande arbetsområden. Fotografering, bildredigering, styling av bostäder, kundkonsultationer och marknadsföring i sociala medier blir viktiga delar av ditt arbete. Vi tror på frihet under ansvar och söker dig som självständigt kan planera, prioritera och driva dina arbetsuppgifter framåt. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter;


Koordinering och administration

* Stötta fastighetsmäklarna i det dagliga arbetet.
* Koordinera fotograferingar, visningar och andra aktiviteter.
* Ha kontakt med kunder och samarbetspartners.
* Hantera administration samt ta fram och kvalitetssäkra annonser och prospekt.


Fotografering och visuellt innehåll

* Ansvara för och genomföra bostadsfotograferingar.
* Redigera och efterbearbeta bilder.
* Filma och skapa rörligt material till annonser och sociala medier.
* Utveckla vårt visuella uttryck och marknadsföringsmaterial.


Styling och försäljning

* Ansvara för styling av utvalda bostäder.
* Genomföra kundkonsultationer och ge stylingråd inför fotografering och försäljning.
* Inspirera kunder och sälja in våra stylingtjänster och övriga tilläggstjänster.


Sociala medier och marknadsföring

* Skapa och publicera innehåll på Instagram, Facebook och TikTok.
* Ta fram idéer till kampanjer, inlägg och kreativ marknadsföring.
* Skapa enklare grafiskt material och bidra till att stärka vårt varumärke.

 **Om oss**  

Vårt kontor finns i centrala Uppsala och har funnits lokalt på marknaden i ca 25 år. Vi är väletablerade på marknaden och satsar stort. Vi hoppas kunna bli den mest rekommenderade och attraktiva mäklarfirman i Uppsala. Tillsammans ska vi se till att stärka vår position ytterligare på marknaden och som säljkoordinator är du en viktig del i det arbetet tillsammans med oss. Med kontorens gedigna erfarenhet och rutiner inom fastighetsmäklarbranschen har vi även goda samarbeten med banker och samarbetspartners. Vi är ett glatt gäng som jobbar hårt mot gemensamma och egna mål. Men vi ser även till att ha riktigt kul tillsammans både på kontoret och utanför.  

  

**Om dig**

* Är strukturerad, självgående och ansvarstagande.
* Tar egna initiativ och ser vad som behöver göras.
* Har ett genuint intresse för inredning, styling och fotografering.
* Har känsla för färg, form, ljus och bildkomposition.
* Är social, kommunikativ och trygg i kundkontakter.
* Har ett naturligt affärstänk och tycker om försäljning.
* Har god datorvana och lätt för att lära dig nya system.


Meriterande erfarenheter

* Homestyling, inredning eller inredningskonsultation.
* Bostadsfotografering, kamera och ljussättning.
* Bildredigering, exempelvis Photoshop eller Lightroom.
* Filmning, videoredigering och contentproduktion.
* Sociala medier och digital marknadsföring.
* Grafisk design, Canva eller Adobe Creative Cloud.
* Fastighetsmäklarbranschen, försäljning eller kundrådgivning.


Du behöver inte kunna allt. Vi värdesätter framför allt rätt personlighet, engagemang och en vilja att utvecklas.  

  

**Övrigt**  

Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning.  

Start omgående eller enligt ö.k.  

Bifoga ev. portfolio, fotografier, stylingprojekt eller exempel på innehåll du skapat för sociala medier under Övriga dokument i ansökan. Vi är särskilt nyfikna på din fotografiska känsla och visuella kreativitet.  

Vi erbjuder fast grundlön i kombination med provision baserad på stylinguppdrag och försäljning av tilläggstjänster.  

Välkommen med din ansökan och hör av dig till franchisetagare Jan Liljeqvist för mer information, **jan.liljeqvist@husmanhagberg.se**
  

  

Är du den vi söker eller känner du någon som passar? Välkommen med din ansökan!

 **Om HusmanHagberg**  

Våra ledord är Äkta, Passionerade Vinnare! Här får du vara en del av en expansiv kedja med ett framgångsrikt koncept, ett öppet och prestigelöst klimat i positiv anda med oberoende franchisegivare. Vi är idag cirka 430 medarbetare, utspridda på 100 kontor från norr till söder samt Spanien. Vi är ett företag där vi har otroligt roligt tillsammans samtidigt som vi ger våra kunder hög service och strävar alltid efter god lönsamhet för dig. HusmanHagberg har en tydlig vision om att bli Sveriges bästa fastighetsmäklarkedja. Hos oss får du förmedla både villor, bostadsrätter, tomter och nyproduktion. Vi är ett av de ledande mäklarföretagen i Sverige och vill fortsätta utveckla vår position tillsammans med dig.

title: HiveAI Engineering Manager
description:
**AI is changing not only what software we build, but how we build it. As our HiveAI Engineering Manager, you will lead the team at the centre of that shift. You will combine people leadership, strong engineering judgement and AI-assisted development to turn ideas into production-ready products faster.**


This is an opportunity to help shape both a product and the way of working around it. You will build and lead a small, high-trust development team where AI accelerates engineering without compromising quality, security or maintainability.

**About the role**
==================


As Engineering Manager for HiveAI, you **lead the people and shape how the team works and delivers**. You will lead an international team with developers based across several Fellowmind countries, so building trust, alignment and a strong team culture across locations will be an important part of your leadership.


You will work as a peer alongside our Product Manager and Chief Architect, each with a clear but closely connected area of ownership. The Product Manager drives the why and what. The Chief Architect sets the technical direction and guardrails. You lead the team and create the conditions for great engineering.


The way we build matters. The HiveAI team works from problems and hypotheses, using AI to move quickly from idea to experiment and prototype. What proves valuable is then hardened into secure, scalable and maintainable software. You will help define what this way of working looks like in practice as the team grows.


You will lead a team that brings together **platform developers**, who build and maintain HiveAI itself, and **Frontier Fellows (Forward Deployed Engineers)**, who work close to our implementation teams and customers and bring what they learn and build back into the product. Your job is to bring these two perspectives together as one engineering team.

#### **What you will do:**

* **Build and lead the team.** Own hiring, 1:1s, development and performance conversations, and build a strong, high-trust engineering culture across a distributed international team.
* **Design the way we deliver.** Drive fast build-and-learn cycles, remove impediments and favour working demos and clear ship, change or stop decisions.
* **Turn prototypes into products.** Together with the Chief Architect, make sure promising experiments cross the line into production with the engineering quality they need.
* **Make AI a real engineering capability.** Coach developers in prompting, coding agents, AI-assisted testing and code review, and continuously evolve how the team works with AI.
* **Protect engineering understanding.** AI should make engineers faster and help them learn, not become a substitute for understanding the systems they build.
* **Keep the focus on outcomes.** Build a team that makes good decisions about what to build, how to build it and when AI is, and is not, the right tool.
**Who are you?**
================

**You are a people leader who still thinks like an engineer.**


You probably spent a significant part of your career as a software developer before moving into technical and people leadership. Today, you might be an **Engineering Manager, Software Development Manager or a Tech Lead with people responsibility**, ideally in a SaaS or software product company.


You are comfortable when the destination is clearer than the route to get there. You coach and enable your team, make good decisions with incomplete information and know when a fast prototype is good enough to learn from, but not good enough to ship.

#### **We believe that you bring:**

* Extensive professional experience in **software development**, followed by at least **2–3 years of people leadership**, either as an Engineering Manager or as a Tech Lead with direct people responsibility.
* Hands-on experience using **AI coding tools and agents**, such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code or similar, as part of real software development.
* Strong engineering practices across **CI/CD, automated testing, code review and secure development.**
* Experience from a **SaaS or software product environment,** where teams own what they build beyond the first release.
* Experience leading **distributed or international teams**, with the ability to coach, communicate and build a strong team culture across locations, mainly through digital ways of working.
* Experience with **Azure and the Microsoft technology stack**, which is highly valuable given HiveAI's technology landscape.
* The ability to start from a problem statement and a hypothesis, and to shape the route to a solution together with the team as you learn.
* Professional proficiency in **English and the local language of the country in which you are applying: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.**

You do not need to be the person writing the most code in the team. What matters is your technical background. It gives you the credibility and judgement to coach great engineers and challenge decisions. It also lets you create an environment where they can move exceptionally fast without losing control of what they build.

**What is HiveAI?**
===================


At Fellowmind, we're building HiveAI, a platform for developing, deploying and operating AI solutions at scale. It provides a secure and scalable foundation for enterprise AI and enables organisations to move beyond isolated experiments towards AI solutions that become part of how the business actually operates.


At its core is the HiveAI Technology, built on Microsoft Azure, which provides the foundation for deploying, scaling and managing AI agents securely. Around it sits the HiveAI Agent Lifecycle, helping organisations develop, deploy, manage and continuously improve their AI agents over time.


Read more about Fellowmind HiveAI.

**Why Fellowmind?**
===================


You will join HiveAI at a stage where there is still plenty to shape. You will have real influence on how the team, the product and the way of working take form, with an international organisation and the Microsoft ecosystem behind you.


Fellowmind combines deep industry knowledge and personal guidance with Microsoft cloud technology across ERP, cloud infrastructure, data & AI, CRM, intranet and Modern Workplace. We are an international organisation with more than 2,000 colleagues across Europe.


Our culture is built around putting people at the heart of what we do. We value collaboration, personal responsibility, development and the freedom to find a sustainable balance between work and life.

**The practicalities**
======================

**Start:** As soon as possible, but of course we'll take your notice period into account.
  

**Scope:** Full-time.
  

**Location:** This role can be based in Sweden, Denmark or the Netherlands, from one of our Fellowmind offices.
  

**Travel:** This is an international role, so occasional travel between Fellowmind countries is a natural part of the job.
  

**Language:** Professional proficiency in English and the local language of your country of employment: Swedish, Danish or Dutch.
  

**Process:** Initial screening interview, in-depth interviews, assessments/case work and reference checks.

title: Medarbetare till Specialorder - vikariat
description:
**Anställningsform:** vikariat **| Tillträdesdag:** 4 januari **| Ansök senast:** 29 november, urval sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan


Motiveras du av kundkontakt, problemlösning och att ta ansvar för att det blir rätt hela vägen? Till Specialorder söker vi dig som trivs i en händelserik vardag där kund, digitala system och logistik möts. Den här tjänsten är ett vikariat som sträcker sig fram till 13 augusti 2027.


Specialorder är en del av Spendrups kundservice där kundkontakt, orderhantering och logistik möts. Teamet ansvarar för att hantera beställningar och kundärenden, säkerställa kvalitet genom hela orderflödet och lösa de avvikelser som kan uppstå på vägen. Rollen innebär många kontaktytor, både med kunder och med andra delar av Spendrups, och ett tydligt fokus på att kunden ska få rätt hjälp och rätt leverans.

**Dina viktigaste arbetsuppgifter**

* Ta emot och hantera kundbeställningar och ärenden via e-handel, mejl, telefon och andra digitala kanaler.
* Säkerställa korrekt orderregistrering och hög kvalitet genom hela orderflödet.
* Följa upp och hantera avvikelser som exempelvis restorder, returorder, leveransproblem och plockfel.
* Felsöka och söka information i våra system för att driva ärenden vidare till lösning.
* Ge kunder tydlig och professionell återkoppling samt stötta dem i användningen av vår e-handel.
* Dokumentera och administrera ärenden i våra affärs- och CRM-system.
* Samarbeta med kollegor och andra interna funktioner för att lösa kund- och leveransrelaterade frågor.
* Bidra med förbättringsförslag och utveckling av rutiner, processer och digitala arbetssätt.

**Vi söker dig som har**

* Erfarenhet av kundtjänst där tempot varit högt och service, administration och kvalitet varit viktiga delar.
* God digital vana och förmåga att arbeta strukturerat i flera system parallellt.
* Förståelse för digitala flöden, ärendehantering och vikten av korrekt information och datakvalitet.
* Förmåga att självständigt söka information, felsöka och driva ärenden framåt.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig tydligt och professionellt på svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.
* Goda kunskaper i Microsoft 365/Officepaketet.
* Relevant gymnasie- eller eftergymnasial utbildning.

**Vi blir också glada om du har**

* Erfarenhet av Salesforce och/eller M3 Cloud.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med logistik-, transport- eller leveransrelaterade frågor.
* Erfarenhet av e-handel och digitala kund- eller orderflöden.

**Personliga egenskaper vi värdesätter**


För att trivas och lyckas på Specialorder behöver du uppskatta kombinationen av kundkontakt, problemlösning och administrativ noggrannhet. Du arbetar strukturerat även när tempot är högt och kan prioritera mellan inkommande ärenden, avvikelser och uppföljningar utan att tappa helheten.


Du tar ansvar för att ditt arbete håller hög kvalitet och driver dina ärenden framåt. När något inte går enligt plan söker du aktivt information, identifierar möjliga lösningar och tar hjälp när det behövs. Du är serviceinriktad och tydlig i din kommunikation och förstår hur ditt eget arbete påverkar både kunden och kollegorna i nästa steg.


Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som delar med dig av kunskap och bidrar till att teamet lyckas tillsammans. Du är nyfiken på nya arbetssätt och digitala lösningar, vågar uppmärksamma sådant som kan göras bättre och ser förändring som en naturlig del av arbetet. Hos oss är det viktigt att vara öppen och respektfull, hålla det du lovar och ta ansvar även när något blivit fel.

**Företagsmiljö**


Vi sitter i fina nyrenoverade lokaler på Sankt Eriksgatan 119 i Vasastaden. På Spendrups Bryggeri är vi en aktiv arbetsplats med roliga aktiviteter som afterworks och friskvårdsinitiativ. Vi erbjuder ett friskvårdsbidrag på 4000 kr per år för att främja hälsa och välmående. Vi värdesätter närvaro på kontoret men erbjuder också möjlighet att jobba på distans två dagar i veckan då arbetet tillåter det.

**Kontaktperson**: Elli León, chef Specialorder

**Din ansökan**


För denna tjänst behöver vi inget personligt brev, du ansöker istället genom att svara på några korta urvalsfrågor och bifoga ditt CV. Om du uppfyller kraven kommer du även att få göra två urvalstester från Alva Labs som skickas till din mejl.

*Slutkandidater kommer efter sitt godkännande att omfattas av en bakgrundskontroll.*


Spendrups vision är att vara ett bryggeri i världsklass. Det innebär att vi stolt vill kunna jämföra oss med de bästa i världen i allt vi gör. Det gäller de produkter vi lanserar och de relationer vi bygger, hur vi agerar i nuet och hur vi satsar på sikt. Vår mission är att med kreativ kraft, långsiktigt ansvarstagande och passion skapa smakupplevelser och relationer i världsklass. Som medarbetare på Spendrups har du en viktig roll i vår gemensamma strävan mot världsklass och vi ser gärna att du identifierar dig själv med våra värderingar: Äkthet, Nyskapande och Handlingskraft.

 **Välkommen in!**

title: AI Engineer
description:
**About Seventy**


Seventy Agency is a strategic brand and marketing agency. We help companies grow by optimizing


and connecting brand, growth and marketing operations. We don't stop at strategy: we build the


systems, content and ways of working that make it happen.


We build on many years of developing brand and marketing with companies from every corner of


the world and in all types of industries, from global B2B tech companies to large industrial groups


and international consumer brands.


Seventy is part of a group of agencies that brings together strategy, creative work, production and


managed marketing services, as well as transformation of marketing organisations and operations.


Together we cover the whole chain, from brand and strategy to campaigns, content and the daily


marketing work inside our clients' own teams. We are a partner that drives change and stays to


keep developing with our clients. With all competences working together, the pace we drive


change at is high and the solutions we provide deliver tangible results.


We are now expanding our marketing operations team. We help marketing teams change how they


work, from data and tools to production, localization and follow-up, powered by AI. We build


solutions that empower marketing teams in their daily work. To grow the team, we're looking for


new talent to join us.

 **The role**

* You'll join our AI team as AI Engineer, working side by side with our AI Architect. You're equals with different mandates: they design, you build and run.
* You own how our solutions are built, shipped and kept running, and you own the library of components the team reuses across clients.
* Your first project is with a large client, where you'll turn an architecture for AI in marketing into working systems, step by step, together with the client's IT team.

 **What you'll do**

* Turn the architecture into a delivery plan with clear steps, dependencies and what each step needs from the client's IT team.
* Build the connections between the client's data sources and the agents that use them. These include web analytics, search console, ad platforms, AI visibility tools and the brand portal.
* Set up data pipelines, storage and access in line with the client's security and retention rules.
* Build agents and workflows, including tool use, retrieval and output validation, and connect them to the interface the client's teams use, for example Microsoft Copilot.
* Build everything as components the team can reuse for other clients, and own our solution library.
* Build and run interim solutions with an agreed end date and handover plan, when the client's global projects aren't ready yet.
* Own testing, evaluation, monitoring and logging, so we know how the agents behave in
* production and catch problems before users do.
* Be the day to day contact for the client's developers and infrastructure team: environments, access, security reviews and deployments.
* Document what you build, and bring in and lead freelancers when the work grows.

 **Who you are**

* You have several years as a software or data engineer, and you've built and run systems based on large language models in production.
* You're hands-on with APIs, MCP servers, integrations, data pipelines and cloud platforms, preferably Azure. You write production code in Python or TypeScript.
* You're comfortable in enterprise Microsoft environments.
* You've led technical delivery, with other developers or freelancers.
* Experience with marketing and analytics data (GA4, Search Console, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads) is a strong plus.
* You want to grow with a team and take on more responsibility over time.
* You're based in Stockholm or nearby. You speak and work in English, and preferably Swedish.

 **What we offer**

* To be an important part of a fast growing team that helps clients transform marketing with AI.
* Real problems and real projects from day one with clients our agencies are already deeply engaged in.
* To build systems that change how the client's full-time marketing teams work, and components that grow into a platform for many clients.

 **How to apply**  

Send in your CV and cover letter. We are interviewing on an ongoing basis and would like to fill the role as soon as possible.

title: Mjukvaruchef till teknikbolag inom optiska nätverk
description:
Om rollen Som mjukvaruchef tar du här över en grupp på cirka 15 utvecklare inom fullstack och embedded, med tyngdpunkt på webb. Gruppen arbetar mycket AI-fokuserat och bygger nu också en gemensam software factory där kunskap och arbetssätt samlas och delas. Du får en central roll i hur bolaget utvecklar mjukvara framåt. I teamet finns allt från seniora ingenjörer till juniora utvecklare, och din uppgift är att ge alla medarbetare rätt förutsättningar att växa.
  
  

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Leda och utveckla en grupp på cirka 15 mjukvaruutvecklare inom fullstack och embedded Ha fullt personalansvar med 1:1-samtal, lönesamtal, uppföljning och administration Driva gruppens AI-baserade arbetssätt framåt tillsammans med teamet Delta i projektgrupper som utvecklar arbetssätt och verktyg inom AI Vara en närvarande förebild och hålla dig uppdaterad om allt som händer i gruppen Samarbeta med övriga chefer inom R&D, bland annat inom test och hårdvara Vi söker dig som Har minst 5 års erfarenhet som chef eller ledare med personalansvar Har erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling och förstår hur moderna utvecklingsteam arbetar Är nyfiken på AI-baserad utveckling och gärna har praktisk erfarenhet av det Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska och engelska Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av hårdvara eller inbyggda system eller har arbetat med teknikintensiva produkter, till exempel inom telekom. Som person är du ödmjuk och har ett genuint intresse för både människor och teknik. Du ser dig aldrig som fullärd och trivs med att leda en grupp med olika personligheter och erfarenhetsnivåer. Du är strukturerad, följer upp och vill vara på plats med ditt team.
  
  

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. Övrig information Start: Enligt överenskommelse Plats: Kista, Stockholm. Rollen bygger på närvaro och målet är att vara på kontoret fem dagar i veckan. Omfattning: Heltid Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning Förmåner: Bland annat tjänstepension, sjukvårdsförsäkring, bonus och sex veckors semester Tester kan ingå i rekryteringsprocessen.
  
  

Urvalet sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag! Om företaget Företaget är ett internationellt teknikbolag som utvecklar lösningar för optiska nätverk. Bland kunderna finns telekom- och kabeloperatörer, molnleverantörer, internetknutpunkter och myndigheter världen över. Utvecklingen sker i Kista, där mjukvara, hårdvara, test och produktledning arbetar nära varandra.
  
  

Här är vägen till beslut kort och du får vara med och forma hur ett teknikbolag utvecklar mjukvara med AI. Om Wrknest Engineering Wrknest Engineering är specialiserade på att hjälpa dig som ingenjör eller tekniker att hitta nästa steg i karriären. Vi samarbetar med framtidens företag och erbjuder både rekryterings- och konsultuppdrag inom teknik och industri – alltid med människan i centrum. Vi tror på att bygga långsiktiga relationer och strävar efter att vara en engagerad och lyhörd partner.
  
  

Via oss får du möjlighet att vara en del av tekniska framsteg som formar morgondagens samhälle – i roller där din kunskap gör verklig skillnad. Vår ambition är att du ska trivas, utvecklas och känna dig stolt över ditt arbete. Läs mer på www.wrknestengineering.se. Ansök nu!
